story.titleZh: 梅赛德斯车队美国站赛后采访
story.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯车队在赛后采访中分享了他们的激动心情，表示在周五之后没有人预料到能赢得比赛，能够扭转周末的局面非常特别。

💬 “What an incredible feeling. After Friday, I don’t think any of us expected to be standing here with the win, so to turn the weekend around like this is really special.”
